notes.title: Patch 004
notes.content:
- Debug level 11 ending
- Cubes and letters of the factory colors are more distinct
- Processor is less charged on levels 5 and 8 (mirror)
- More feedbacks at the level 7 ending
- Debug of windowed mode (weird black bands)

notes.title: Patch 003
notes.content:
- Always more feedbacks !
- Cursor is now bigger when looking at interactable object and pickable object
- Sound added when carrying an object or releasing it
- (level 7 ) Kyle now gives whole speech to explain how to create robots when first talked

notes.title: Patch 002
notes.content:
- Bob the cop (lvl 3) is now way more stable ! He's gonna catch you ! :D
- Updated save system in case of several steam accounts on the same computer (now one file per user id)
- Corrected a bug in the brain factory where you could fall through the big door
